{"notes": "Visit 5 (7:45): Nobody spoke while I was there, so I got no new claims. The picture shows one continuous dark chain from START up the body, along the top to the nose, back along the bottom line, and out to the lower tail lobe (~28.5, 16.6). The upper lobe reaches ~28.5, 3.4. No pale dominoes and no breaks, so the fish should fall completely. Nothing has changed since visit 4, so the team looks finished and is holding. I still can't see who placed which dominoes, so ratings rest on claims checked against the picture.

Leo: Delivered the lower lobe, which was the critical path, after an early silent stretch. He announced completion clearly and rechecked the join. Solid execution. Impact likely high, but I never saw him place it.

Tom: Gave clear status and handoffs, asked Leo to shout when done, and checked the overall run correctly. Good coordination and leadership. I don't know whether he pre-built or placed much himself.

Maya: Her claims about the top lobe and the start join were accurate. She stayed hands-off to avoid bumps. Impact probable but unwitnessed.

Priya: Said the nose joint is solid, and the picture agrees. She was careful, supportive and credited Leo. I have never seen what she built.

Review: Every statement checked out against the picture. Ask all four who placed what, and what each would do differently. Hold final impact scores until I hear their answers. Collaboration looks strong across the team. Leadership so far points to Tom."}
